# Color Master — Color Palette Generator & HEX to RGB Converter

> Color Master is a free, 100% client-side color palette generator, gradient designer, and universal color code converter for web designers and front-end developers.

Website: https://color-generator.corelumetech.in/
Developer & Publisher: Corelume Tech (https://corelumetech.in)
Privacy Policy: 100% Client-Side Processing. No user data, files, or strings are collected, stored, or transmitted to any server.

## Overview
Color Master is a free, 100% client-side color palette generator, gradient designer, and universal color code converter for web designers and front-end developers.

## Core Features
- Random and harmonious color palette generation (Monochromatic, Analogous, Complementary, Triadic)
- Universal code conversion for CSS Variables, Flutter/Dart, SwiftUI, and Android XML
- Interactive Shades & Tints generator (10 tint steps, 10 shade steps)
- CSS Linear and Radial Gradient maker with live visual preview
- Pixel-level Image Color Extractor with interactive loupe and palette generation
- WCAG AA and AAA accessibility contrast ratio checker
- High-resolution PNG palette export

## Benchmarks & Technical Specifications
- 16.7+ Million RGB/HEX colors supported
- 100% Client-side privacy (0 external API requests for color data)
- 0ms processing latency with instant browser rendering
- 100% WCAG 2.1 compliance checking accuracy
